name: These Boots Are Made for Walkin'

podcast.body: Nancy Sinatra's 1966 hit was featured in one of the most famous Scopatone films. Scopatones were video jukeboxes, weighing 1,500 pounds and capable of playing three dozen 16-millimeter films, most of which were in color and shot exclusively for the machine. "The most famous Scopatone movie featured Nancy Sinatra's 1966 hit, These Boots Are Made For Walking."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Future of the Music Video - Part 1

podcast.body: This song was part of the loud music bombardment directed at the Branch Davidian cult compound in Waco, Texas, in 1993. It was one of the methods used by authorities to try and break the will of David Koresh and his followers during a 51-day standoff. "That playlist included AQ Breaking Heart by Billy Ray Cyrus, Nancy Sinatra, these boots are made for Wacan, some chanting by Tibetan monks, songs by Andy Williams, and some Christmas sing-alongs by Mitch Miller from the 1950s."
